items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: John Hammond has to have all the credit for that because he was the driving force behind the scenes of forming that Goodman Trio and putting me on an equal basis with Krupa in public

ctx.x: But there must have been somebody or someone that had seen -- well, you are the one who can do this, you are the one that can pull this off.

Well, the credit for that thing is -- and we're jumping a little bit ahead of our story, but this is very important and we can go back to the story. -- John Hammond has to have all the credit for that because he was the driving force behind the scenes of forming that Goodman Trio and putting me on an equal basis with Krupa in public -- away from the recording studio. But in public, right out in the open, he pushed and pressured Goodman to add me on as a regular member of the band, because Goodman and I had made…
